claims.claim: Mean top-3 Jaccard agreement between an assessed Kernel SHAP run and eight reruns is 0.8065 at budget 4d and 0.9315 at 16d (abstract 0.807/0.932), averaged over three held-out datasets, three model families, two seeds and 20 instances per cell.
The difference between mean agreement at 16d and 4d is 0.125 (derived).
Share of assessed-rerun pairs with non-identical top-3 sets lies between 19.3% and 38.7% at 4d and between 6.8% and 13.7% at 16d (derived from mean labels via Jaccard values 0,0.2,0.5,1).
The diagnostic's score (1-MSE) in the sealed final evaluation is 0.9838, i.e. MSE 0.0162 and RMSE 0.127 (derived).
Skill (MSE reduction) over always-reliable is 0.0353 with one-sided 2.5th-percentile bootstrap lower bound 0.0171.
Skill over constant 0.5 is 0.1543 with lower bound 0.1245.
Skill over the split-half-gap heuristic is 0.0122 with lower bound 0.0081.
The pairing-permuted control scores 0.9701; the diagnostic exceeds it by 0.0137 (derived) with lower bound 0.0101.

Relative MSE reductions by the diagnostic are 68.5% vs always-reliable, 90.5% vs constant 0.5, 42.9% vs split-half gap and 45.9% vs permuted control; comparator MSEs 0.0515, 0.1705, 0.0284, 0.0299 and RMSEs 0.227, 0.413, 0.169, 0.173 (derived).
Of the 0.0353 MSE reduction over always-reliable, 0.0216 (61%) is retained under within-episode permutation and 0.0137 (39%) is instance-specific (derived).
Mean within-episode Spearman correlation between predicted and actual reproducibility is 0.5809 (episodes with a constant vector count as zero by evaluator convention).
Per-seed final scores are 0.9850 (seed 9001) and 0.9826 (seed 9002), a difference of 0.0025; per-seed sweeps took 53.3 s and 53.8 s.

The sealed final evaluation completed with recorded outcome qualified and validity flag true; candidate diagnostics trust is unverified; the four lower bounds (three skills and diagnostic-minus-control) are all positive.
The mean label deficit 1-y averaged over the two budgets is 0.131 (derived).
The budget prior constants 0.84 and 0.96 exceed the final label means by 0.0335 at 4d and 0.0285 at 16d (derived; constants read from selected configuration source).
The selected configuration scored 0.9854 on the search plane (per seed 0.9840 and 0.9869), a development proxy used for selection among three configurations.
Search-plane scores of the three configurations are 0.9760 (A: 0.9740/0.9779), 0.9837 (B: 0.9824/0.9849) and 0.9854 (C: 0.9840/0.9869); all three completed and none was unscored.

Protocol facts (36 episodes, 720 labeled instances, 8 reruns, 20 derangements, 200 bootstrap replicates, seeds 9001/9002, budgets 4d/16d, d=10/10/20) are read from source files, not from the sealed metrics: source_evidence/evaluator_final.py (line 42 seeds; lines 66-72 full-protocol constants; lines 761-812 kernel_coalitions; lines 861-872 derangements) and source_evidence/task_contract.json. The only sealed-evidence record that corroborates part of this is the per-seed episode record (two seeds).

Diagnostic constants (8 folds, 4 partitions, 1000 antithetic draws, simulator weights 0.5/0.2/0.3, shrinkage 0.6/0.4, prior 0.84/0.96, margin 0.02, scale 3) are read from the source file of the selected configuration (source_evidence/selected_config_program.py: constants lines 35-46, weights lines 55-63), whose program directory is recorded under result.improvement_003. They are not sealed metrics; the configuration's notes state the constants were hand-set and untuned and that no code was executed when writing it.
Kernel SHAP casts Shapley estimation as weighted regression over sampled coalitions.

Kernel SHAP variance reduction and alternative estimators: paired sampling and regression refinements, permutation sampling, leverage-score sampling, amortized estimators, and an empirical comparison on tabular data.
Value-function choice changes what a Shapley attribution means; additive attributions can misrepresent interactions.
Local explanations vary under perturbation and across methods; background size affects SHAP stability for deep models.
Predictive multiplicity, feature-selection stability with chance correction, rank-biased overlap and population-level Shapley importance inference are related measurement notions.

Datasets, models and context: folktables ACS income, scikit-learn model families, deep tabular architectures, tree-versus-neural comparisons, tree-specific Shapley algorithms and rigorous interpretability evaluation.
Practitioner studies report feature attributions as a widely deployed form of explanation.
Prior work on sampled local explainers quantifies repeat-run stability of LIME (stability indices) and models uncertainty of LIME and Kernel SHAP explanations with Bayesian local regressions.
The diagnostic's jackknife covariance follows the delete-a-group jackknife, and its shrinkage toward a prior is described as empirical-Bayes-style in the sense of Stein-type estimators.

The budget-prior constants 0.84 and 0.96 are hand-set. The configuration's notes (source_evidence/selected_config_NOTES.md, 'Provenance of constants') describe them as aggregate label means by budget seen in earlier evaluation metrics; those means are not retained in the evidence, so the origin is unverified. They are not the sealed-final label means (0.8065 and 0.9315).

The German Credit final dataset is the complementary hash-parity half of the search-plane German Credit split, per source_evidence/final_resources_manifest.json and search_resources_manifest.json (read from those manifests, not from sealed metrics).
